div.h2: Maps+ Setup: basemap and API keys
div.p: Optional. Save a basemap URL or API keys once here so classic Maps+ panels that do not set their own use them. Each section is independent: fill in only what you use and leave the rest empty. You need admin rights. Values are stored in this Splunk instance, not in dashboards.
CARTO tiles show an API KEY REQUIRED watermark without a key. Request a free key at carto.com/basemaps/apikey, then paste the full tile URL with ?key=YOUR_KEY, for example:
div.label: Tile URL (Map Tile Override)
div.p: Not a secret. A tile key is visible in every tile request the browser makes. Restrict it in the CARTO dashboard if you can. Classic panels and reports that do not choose their own basemap use it. A panel that sets its own Map Tile, Map Tile Override, OpenFreeMap or Bing option keeps that choice.

Dashboard Studio: Studio panels cannot read saved settings, so add the mapsplus_basemap macro at the end of each map panel's search. It adds a mapTileOverride column that Maps+ uses when the panel has no Map Tile Override of its own:
Used when a panel turns on Bing Maps. Get a key from the Bing Maps Dev Center.
div.label: Bing Maps key

div.h3: Google key (Places search and Street View)
div.p: One key serves the Google Places search control and the Google Street View visualization. In the Google Cloud Console, enable Maps JavaScript API, Places API and Street View for the key.
div.label: Google API key

div.h3: Read this before relying on it

ul.li: Classic panels: a panel that does not choose its own basemap loads the saved tile URL when it renders. For Bing and Google, a panel that turns the service on (Bing Maps, Google Places Search) and names no key of its own uses the saved key. Saved reports also get the values as app defaults. You still turn each service on per panel.

Dashboard Studio: Studio ignores app defaults, and the Maps+ panel runs in a sandboxed frame that cannot read saved settings. The CARTO URL works through the mapsplus_basemap macro described above. Bing and Google keys saved here do not reach Studio panels: they would have to travel in search results, which is not a safe place for a key. In Studio, set the key on each panel instead.

Who can use a saved Bing/Google key: in classic, the viewer's browser reads the key from Splunk, which needs the list_storage_passwords capability. The built-in user and power roles do not have it. Granting it lets that role read every stored password it can see, so grant it with care.
Keys reach the browser: a map key is visible to anyone who can view the map (network tab). Restrict Google and Bing keys by HTTP referrer to your Splunk URL.

Where it applies: the saved values are read from this app (leaflet_maps_app), so they work for classic panels in any app. Reports in other apps may need the same values in that app's savedsearches.conf [default].
